scripts.dev:app: bun run prepare:app && cargo run --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml -- server start
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run build:app && bun run build:docs
scripts.build:ui: bun run clean:ui && bun run typecheck:ui && vite build
scripts.build:docs: bun run clean:docs && vitepress build docs && bun ./scripts/docs-postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run test:app && bun run test:docs
scripts.test:app: bun run prepare:app && cargo test --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features
scripts.clean: bun run clean:app && bun run clean:ui && bun run clean:docs
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ui && bun run lint:app
scripts.lint:app: bun run prepare:app && cargo clippy --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:ui && bun run typecheck:app
scripts.typecheck:ui: bun run typecheck:ui:tsc && bun run typecheck:ui:vue
scripts.typecheck:app: bun run prepare:app && cargo check --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --all-features
scripts.format:check: bun run format:repo:check && bun run format:app:check
